verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes an extensive first-party Sandbox SDK API reference covering the main operations: sandbox creation and reconnection via getSandbox, exec with streaming, stdin and output callbacks, file read/write/mkdir/watch, code interpreter contexts, sessions, ports and preview URLs, tunnels, bucket mounts and snapshots. This lets an agent or program drive the product end to end in code, and a site-wide llms.txt and openapi.json are also published. Missing for 10: a sandbox-specific REST/OpenAPI spec (the API is a TypeScript SDK called from a Worker, and the openapi.json probe is site-wide), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
